context:
Goal: q_max's browser tier finishes, so main's browser read is known and merges are not blocked.
Problem (goal): the full tier is 672 checks and takes about 2 h 45 min to 3 h 10 min on a runner, over the old 180 min cap; nothing hangs. 14-FLOSS alone is 40-45 min.
Based on (measured): run 40740294267 hit the 180 min cap at 2 h 59 min with 623 of 672 done; per-check times sum to 10,587 s of the step's 10,753 s.
Based on (read): q_max #1026 raised the cap to 240 min (merged Nov 4 09:49 CST). Run 41861801325 then finished in 3 h 34 min, under the cap, and ended RED on failing checks (item 260 decides their fix).
Departs from: q_max main (one browser job, 240 min cap) — b runs 14-FLOSS and 14-STILL as a second job with its own port and database.
home: q_max .github/workflows/browser.yml; D-542, the browser tier runs on your dispatch
lane: qmax-browser-slow-checks (session_013NEJL3xPq2aimXrBZLnDUP), started by the coordinator 21:37 CST

lastAnswer.note: im convinced the run can't be doing tihngs right if it needs that long. Routed 21:35 CST Nov 5 to the coordinator for q_max triage: neither a nor b. A lane finds why 672 checks take about 16 s each (10,587 s in all), fixes the cause, and reports the new run time. The item closes when that fix merges.

options.how: No more work: #1026 already raised the cap.
options.label: Keep one job at the 240 min cap
options.lose: A full run takes about 3 h 34 min, close to the cap.

options.gain: A full run finishes sooner, well under the cap.
options.how: A build lane moves 14-FLOSS and 14-STILL to a second job with its own port and database, each with its own count check.
options.label: Split into two parallel jobs
options.lose: One build lane, and a second job to keep.

title: q_max: split the browser tier into two jobs, so a run takes about 2 h instead of 3?
why: Recommended: a. The run finishes with no more work; b saves wait time but costs a build lane and the same runner minutes.
